scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the South Annex courthouse observation make-up reachable by having the required shuttle pass loaded before the future check-in.
Emerging Need: The pass is absent, but it matters only after the general observation hold resolves into the transit-only South Annex assignment.
Decision Context: Stored travel rules and account status identify the missing pass, permitted purchase, product details, cutoff, and limits; live calendar, wallet, and transit notices determine whether purchase is feasible.
Consequence: Timely pass loading preserves attendance at the future supervised sitting, while the evening window closure leaves no roster-attached boarding option.
